What I do

The skills behind the results above.

Audience and geo expansion

Separate campaigns by city and audience. In one test, cost per conversation was ₦100 in Lagos, ₦196 in Abuja and ₦329 in Uyo.

Retargeting

Warm audiences convert cheaper. A skincare retargeting campaign ran at ₦95 per conversation with a 7.1% click-through rate.

Price and offer testing

Same treatment, different prices. Body sculpting cost $6.09 per lead at $149 and $10.00 at $199.

Creative iteration

Demo-style video variants for a home appliance retailer reached ₦92 per conversation.

Recruitment ads

How I plan, test and report

The same simple loop on every account.

Plan

I start with your goal, your offer and your budget. Then I match it to the right Meta objective, whether that is awareness, traffic, engagement, leads or sales, and set up tracking and lead follow-up before any money is spent. I split audiences and locations into separate campaigns.

Test

I launch several creatives and offers side by side and compare cost per result ad by ad. I cut what lags, put budget behind what works, and retarget people who showed interest.

Report

You get a plain-language update on spend, results, cost per result and what I’m changing next. I tie it back to your real sales so we know what the ads are worth.
